jp: たとえ宿題[しゅくだい]が{難[むずか]しくても|cd-temo}、最後[さいご]までやります。
en: Even if the homework is difficult, I will do it to the end.
why: たとえ…ても means even if; the outcome holds whatever the difficulty.

jp: いくら{勉強[べんきょう]しても|cd-temo}、英語[えいご]の単語[たんご]を覚[おぼ]えられません。
en: No matter how much I study, I can't remember the English words.
d: 勉強[べんきょう]すれば
勉強[べんきょう]したら
勉強[べんきょう]すると
why: いくら…ても means no matter how much; the result stays negative regardless.

jp: 熱[ねつ]が{あっても|cd-temo}、大事[だいじ]な会議[かいぎ]には出[で]なければなりません。
en: Even if I have a fever, I have to attend the important meeting.
why: The obligation holds despite the fever, so the concessive ても is needed.

jp: 夜遅[よるおそ]くまで{残業[ざんぎょう]しても|cd-temo}、仕事[しごと]が終[お]わりません。
en: Even if I work overtime until late at night, the work doesn't get finished.
d: 残業[ざんぎょう]すれば
残業[ざんぎょう]したら
残業[ざんぎょう]すると
why: Effort that does not produce the expected result takes ても.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{でも|cd-temo}、この問題[もんだい]は解[と]けません。
en: Even a teacher cannot solve this problem.
why: A noun takes でも for even; the others would make a condition, not a concession.

jp: たとえ試験[しけん]に{落[お]ちても|cd-temo}、あきらめません。
en: Even if I fail the exam, I won't give up.
why: たとえ points to a concession: failing will not change the decision.

jp: 授業[じゅぎょう]が{つまらなくても|cd-temo}、居眠[いねむ]りをしてはいけません。
en: Even if the class is boring, you must not doze off.
why: The prohibition holds regardless of how boring the class is.

jp: 何度[なんど]{聞[き]いても|cd-temo}、この文法[ぶんぽう]がよく分[わ]かりません。
en: No matter how many times I ask, I still don't understand this grammar well.
why: 何度…ても means no matter how many times; the result does not change.

jp: 給料[きゅうりょう]が{安[やす]くても|cd-temo}、この仕事[しごと]が好[す]きだから続[つづ]けます。
en: Even if the pay is low, I like this job, so I will keep it.
why: Low pay does not stop me from continuing, which is the concessive ても.

jp: 毎日[まいにち]{忙[いそが]しくても|cd-temo}、日記[にっき]を書[か]くことにしています。
en: Even when I'm busy every day, I make a point of keeping a diary.
why: A habit kept despite being busy takes ても.

jp: 時間[じかん]が{なくても|cd-temo}、朝[あさ]ご飯[はん]は食[た]べたほうがいいです。
en: Even if you have no time, you should eat breakfast.
why: The advice holds despite the lack of time, so ても is required.
